title: Ask HN: How to benefit from DeepSeek for enterprise use?
content_html:
As the title says.

I've recently been experimenting with the reasonix harness (reasonix.io) for a personal project, and, I am completely blown away by the extremely cheap cost.

This just feels exactly how using AI should be: no concern about the costs, just focus on building and improving software with it.

However, there are the obvious privacy and data sharing concerns when relying on the official DeepSeek APIs. I'm curious if anyone has found ways to work around these limitations?
